record.context_brief: Multidimensional zero-one law for directional transience
record.original_question: For dimension d >= 2 and a nonzero direction l in R^d, find conditions that imply a zero-one law for directional transience, namely that P_0[A_l] is always either 0 or 1, where A_l is the event that X_n · l tends to infinity. In particular, are the assumptions of i.i.d. cookie stacks, a deterministic bound on the number of non-placebo cookies per site, and uniform ellipticity sufficient?

evidence.quote: (IID)              the family (ω(z, ·, ·))z∈Zd of cookie stacks is i.i.d. under P.
(UEL) There is κ > 0 such that for all z ∈ Zd , e ∈ E and i ∈ N : P-a.s. ω(z, e, i) ≥ κ.
(BD)     there is a deterministic M ∈ N such that for all z ∈ Zd : P-a.s. M (z) ≤ M .
For any direction ℓ ∈ Rd \{0} we say that the ERW is transient in direction ℓ if P0 -a.s. Xn · ℓ → ∞ as n → ∞. We set Aℓ := lim Xn · ℓ = ∞ .
Problem 3.20. (d ≥ 2) Find conditions which imply the zero-one law P0 [Aℓ ] ∈ {0, 1} for all ℓ ∈ Rd \{0} (cf. Problem 3.5). Are e.g. (IID), (BD) and (UEL) sufficient

artifact.status_search_result: A full zero-one law for directional transience of multidimensional excited random walks (d ≥ 2) under i.i.d. cookie stacks, bounded number of non-placebo cookies, and uniform ellipticity does not appear to be established. The analogous one-dimensional zero-one law was proved by Amir, Berger, and Orenshtein (2016). In dimension d ≥ 2, only partial results are known (e.g., a zero-one law for P_0[A_ℓ] + P_0[A_{-ℓ}] ∈ {0,1} due to Zerner and refinements), but the dichotomy P_0[A_ℓ] ∈ {0,1} itself remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Zero-one law for directional transience of one dimensional excited random walks (Amir, Berger, Orenshtein)
status_evidence.snippet: The probability that a one dimensional excited random walk in stationary ergodic and elliptic cookie environment is transient to the right (left) is either zero or one. This solves a problem posed by Kosygina and Zerner.
status_evidence.claim: The 1D zero-one law for directional transience of ERW was settled in 2016; the multidimensional analogue is referenced as a separate, harder problem.

status_evidence.title: Recurrence and transience of excited random walks on Z^d and strips
status_evidence.snippet: Excited random walks have been investigated on Z^d, d ≥ 1, with directional drift; only partial zero-one type results are known in dimension d ≥ 2.
status_evidence.claim: In d ≥ 2, only partial zero-one results (e.g., for P_0[A_ℓ]+P_0[A_{-ℓ}]) are available.
